description: Our team will research how water could be brought to the surface of Mars and how it could be stored safely. We will explore scientific ideas, develop the Semente 07 concept, and investigate technologies that could help collect and preserve water on Mars. We will work together, share ideas, and use scientific research to improve our solution.
summary:
Project Name: SEMENTE 07

Project Description

SEMENTE 07 is an invention made up of three main components: a transparent dome, a water extraction mechanism and a 28V generator.

For many years, scientists have been searching for ways to extract water from Mars. Inspired by this challenge, I invented SEMENTE 07.

Main Objective

The main objective of SEMENTE 07 is to extract water from beneath the surface of Mars and bring it to the surface.

Vision
